decision_rule: PASS only with all 86 paired original-versus-extended cases, exactly 22 declared ROCm0 unsupported and 64 supported; for each supported case compare bytes and metadata under each of skip-off and skip-on using the same champion source-bound build and grant, with finite outputs, matching hashes, >=2 in-process own-HIP mapping and positive KFD VRAM samples per invocation, and verified custody. No shared-case or historical-binary equivalence claim.
